Schneider CA1, Saint-Chamond y Renault F: Schneider CA1, Saint-Chamond and Renault FT.
El primer tanque en combatir (Flers-Cour: The first tank to see combat (Flers-Courcelette, 1916). Two 6-pounder guns in side sponsons and a wheeled tail for steering. Very slow.
El tanque de Cambrai. Cañones cortos de: The tank of Cambrai. Short 6-pounder guns in the sponsons, a fuel tank at the rear and an unditching beam.
La versión \"hembra\": barbetas con amet: The "female" version: sponsons with Lewis machine guns instead of cannons, to sweep infantry out of the trenches.
El \"galgo\": tanque medio rápido para e: The "greyhound": a fast medium tank to exploit breakthroughs. Four Hotchkiss machine guns in the rear casemate.
Motor Ricardo y caja epicicloidal: lo ma: Ricardo engine and epicyclic gearbox: a single driver can handle it. Rear observation cupola and 6-pounder guns.
El primer tanque francés: caja blindada: The first French tank: an armored box on Holt tracks, a wire-cutting prow and a short 75 mm on the right.
El primer tanque con torre giratoria de: The first tank with a 360° rotating turret and a rear engine: the layout of every tank that came after. 37 mm Puteaux.
Casco larguísimo que sobresale de las or: A very long hull overhanging the tracks, a 75 mm field gun in the nose and electric transmission. It gets stuck in wide trenches.
Mark IV británico capturado y reparado p: British Mark IV captured and repaired by the Germans, with the Iron Cross painted on. Same 6-pounder guns.
El único tanque alemán fabricado en seri: The only German tank built in series (20 units). A box with 30 mm at the front, a 57 mm gun in the nose and 6 machine guns. 18 crew.
Tanque ligero \"Leichter Kampfwagen\" so: "Leichter Kampfwagen" light tank on a car chassis: engine at the front and a 57 mm in a rear casemate. It never saw combat: historical fiction.
Los FT del Cuerpo de Tanques estadounide: The US Tank Corps FTs at Saint-Mihiel and the Argonne, in olive drab.
Los Mark V del 301.er Batallón de Tanque: The Mark Vs of the 301st Heavy Tank Battalion, which broke the Hindenburg Line alongside the British.
Cañón de campaña alemán: en 1917 y 1918: German field gun: in 1917 and 1918 it was the tanks' worst enemy, with "K" armor-piercing shells.
Tanques ligeros con torre, los primeros: Light tanks with turrets, the first gun-armed mediums, the fast Soviet BTs and the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939).
El tanque británico de los años 20: torr: The British tank of the 1920s: a rotating turret with a 47 mm 3-pounder, engine beside the driver and bogie suspension. Slow but reliable; it lasted until 1939.
Tanque ligero rápido para patrullar el I: Fast light tank to patrol the Empire: a 12.7 mm Vickers heavy machine gun and a 7.7 mm one in a small turret. 14 mm armor.
El primer \"crucero\" británico: torre m: The first British "cruiser": a powered turret with the new 40 mm 2-pounder, which penetrates more than any other gun its size, and two small machine-gun turrets at the front.
Copiado de los tanques de Christie que l: Copied from the Christie tanks the British saw at Soviet maneuvers: big road wheels and nearly 50 km/h. Same 2-pounder as the A9, thin armor.
El heredero del FT: casco de acero fundi: The FT's successor: a 40 mm cast steel hull many guns of the time couldn't penetrate, but slow and armed with the old short 37 mm. France's most produced tank.
Para muchos, el mejor tanque de 1940: ca: For many, the best tank of 1940: a 47 mm cast hull, a 47 mm SA35 that penetrates every German tank, and a radio. Its weak point: the commander does everything alone in the turret.
Fortaleza de 60 mm con dos cañones: 47 m: A 60 mm fortress with two guns: a 47 mm in the turret and a 75 mm howitzer in the hull aimed by turning the whole tank. Very expensive, slow and thirsty, but almost invulnerable in 1938.
Tanque de instrucción convertido en tanq: A training tank turned combat tank: two MG 13 machine guns in a turret offset to the right and 13 mm of armor. In Spain the T-26s far outclassed it.
El caballo de batalla de los primeros añ: The workhorse of the early years: a 20 mm autocannon (10-round bursts) and 14 mm of armor. Fast and easy to drive.
El tanque de combate pensado por Guderia: The battle tank conceived by Guderian: five crew with a radio, a commander's cupola and the 37 mm KwK 36. Only 10 built, with their five big road wheels.
El \"tanque de apoyo\": 75 mm KwK 37 cor: The "support tank": a short 75 mm KwK 37, meant to fire HE at guns and pillboxes. With AP ammo it's still enough against light tanks.
Copia soviética del Vickers 6 toneladas: Soviet copy of the Vickers 6-ton with the excellent 45 mm 20K. In Spain (1936–1939) it dominated the Panzer Is and the Italian tankettes.
\"Tanque rápido\" con suspensión Christi: "Fast tank" with Christie suspension: over 70 km/h, almost flying. Same 45 mm as the T-26 and thin armor. At Fuentes de Ebro (1937) they charged with infantry riding on top.
Tanque de tres torres para romper frente: Three-turreted breakthrough tank: a short 76 mm KT-28 in the middle one and two small machine-gun turrets in front. Six crew and 30 mm at the front.
Tanque ligero de dos torres (le decían M: Twin-turreted light tank (nicknamed Mae West): one with a 12.7 mm machine gun and the other with a 7.62 mm one. Very fast, with rubber suspension.
El M2 con una sola torre y el cañón de 3: The M2 with a single turret and the 37 mm M5 gun: it penetrates more than the Panzer III. 25 mm armor. The M3 Stuart inherited it directly.
El antitanque alemán: liviano y bajo, lo: The German anti-tank gun: light and low, two men can move it.
El antitanque soviético de 45 mm, mismo: The Soviet 45 mm anti-tank gun, the same gun as the T-26.
El antitanque británico de 40 mm, sobre: The British 40 mm anti-tank gun, on its tripod.
Antitanque francés de 25 mm: chico y pre: French 25 mm anti-tank gun: small and accurate.
